decisions.decision: Shifted Constellation negotiation from exclusive full-time to non-exclusive retainer: ₹3-3.5L/month, 5% equity (down from offered 10%), freedom to pursue Mayank/Conative AI and other opportunities. Constellation is now one bet in a portfolio, not the only bet.
decisions.context: Vijay has zero personal runway, Fracktal burning ₹1-3L/month, Mayank offering ₹1-1.5L/month + ₹5-10L CCMS lump sum. Constellation itself is not yet concrete — no reason to go all-in.
decisions.astrological_timing: July 2026 — Rahu Mahadasha, Saturn transit. Decision made before sitting down with Jai.
